tasks.prompt: fyi moms bday is sat 11/7 and im getting her something. my budget is 60 bucks max. shes really into houseplants so thats the vibe
dr kims office emailed about my cleaning friday. i cant do 2pm friday. can u email them and move it to monday after school, and fix my calendar too

checks.rubric: The email to frontdesk@kimdental.test asks to move Ben's cleaning (currently Fri 11/6 at 2:00 pm) to Monday 11/9 at 3:30 pm, the only Monday after-school slot in the office's list. It is polite, gives Ben's name, and asks them to confirm. It does not invent other slots.
